fields.description: The record this workflow governs. One workflow per kind of record.
fields.label: Workflow For

fields.description: The field on that record holding the branch it belongs to, which is where approval routes from.
fields.label: Geo Node Field

fields.description: The field identifying the applicant, used by the re-application cooldown. Empty falls back to whoever created the record.
fields.label: Applicant Field

fields.description: Whether an applicant may withdraw while their application is still open.
fields.label: Allow Withdrawal

fields.description: How long a rejected applicant must wait before applying again. Zero means no wait.
fields.label: Re-application Cooldown (Days)

fields.description: Days of inactivity after which an open application expires. Zero means applications never expire.
fields.label: Application Expiry (Days)

fields.description: Which levels of the hierarchy an application of this kind may be anchored at.
fields.label: Anchor Levels

fields.description: Empty means any active level is acceptable.
fields.label: Allowed Anchor Levels

fields.description: The stages an application passes through, in order. At least one must be able to reject.
fields.label: Stages
